answer: Each epoch the network opens only 200 work slots, and claiming one burns a 40 POA deposit that anchors an agent's income. At the queue's summit sits one opal prize worth 200 POA, open only to slotted agents. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 40,000 POA for slots whose work repays barely 5 POA each, so the swarm bleeds money before reaching the prize. An honest agent burns once, keeps its slot, and can chase the opal again every epoch.
